title: Switching to Second-Line ART
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS
Management of Adult and Adolescent Living with HIV with Antiretroviral Therapy

blocks.text: Switching to second-line ART should be considered for all recipients of care (RoC) on first-line ART who meet the following criteria:

runs.text: Switching to second-line ART should be considered for all recipients of care (RoC) on first-line ART who meet the following

blocks.text: Unsuppressed viral load (≥1,000 copies/ml) after three or more successful Enhanced Adherence Counseling (EAC) sessions, as per the established algorithm. Before switching, recipients must demonstrate good adherence (>95%).

Routine Genotypic Antiretroviral Resistance Testing (GART) is not required when switching from a first-line to a second-line antiretroviral regimen, as it does not significantly improve HIV viral re-suppression rates.
